$$
\begin{array}{l} I (X, Y) - H _ {K} (f) \leq \operatorname * {E} _ {(x, y) \sim (X, Y)} [ I _ {K} (x, y) ] \\ \leq I (X, Y) + 2 H _ {K} (f). \\ \end{array}
$$
